title: Cake for 25 guests near Tallawong? A 12-inch eggless serves 25-30
summary:
Feeding 25 people near Tallawong or Stanhope Gardens and not sure what size to order? A 12-inch serves 25 to 30 and starts at $89.99.

Every cake from our Riverstone Shopping Centre store is 100% eggless, so no one at the table has to ask. Pick from 15 flavours, including Mango, Tiramisu and Red Velvet, in buttercream, fondant or ganache. Bring a reference photo and we match it.

One size up from the guest count is the rule we give. A cake that runs short is a bigger problem than one with a slice left over.

Cakes need 2 days' notice. Collect from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking. Send your date and guest count and we'll confirm the size.
